keyPhrases.text: not a moment in its compact two and a half hours when I wasn't fully engaged, moved and inspired

reasoning: Overwhelmingly positive review with superlatives throughout ('astonishing,' 'magnificently,' 'perfect cast'). The only criticism is a brief acknowledgment that it might be 'too sentimental' which the critic immediately dismisses. Strong engagement and inspiration expressed, indicating a rave review in the 5-star range.
